# uptimeeye_notification_integration (Resource)

A notification integration delivers alerts of a notification channel to a specific target (Slack, Teams, Discord, email, webhook, Telegram, or PagerDuty). Exactly one integration type attribute must be configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeeye_notification_integration" "slack" {
  channel_id = uptimeeye_notification_channel.oncall.id
  name       = "Slack #alerts"

  slack = {
    webhook_url = var.slack_webhook_url
    channel     = "#alerts"
  }
}

resource "uptimeeye_notification_integration" "pagerduty" {
  channel_id = uptimeeye_notification_channel.oncall.id
  name       = "PagerDuty"

  pagerduty = {
    routing_key = var.pagerduty_routing_key
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the notification channel this integration belongs to. Changing this forces a new integration.
- `name` (String) Display name of the integration.

### Optional

- `discord` (Attributes) Discord integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discord))
- `email` (Attributes) Email integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email))
- `pagerduty` (Attributes) PagerDuty integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagerduty))
- `slack` (Attributes) Slack integration. The API never returns the webhook URL, so drift on it cannot be detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `teams` (Attributes) Microsoft Teams integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))
- `telegram` (Attributes) Telegram integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telegram))
- `webhook` (Attributes) Generic webhook integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Integration identifier.
